title: ZenCart
shortDescription: Enterprise e-commerce backend architecture built with Java 17, Spring Boot 3.4.2, and Spring Security.
longDescription: ZenCart is a robust, enterprise-grade e-commerce backend architecture. It features structured domain modeling, relational persistence through Spring Data JPA, and security layers built with Spring Security. The system architecture includes logical data models (logicalmodel.drawio) and layered enterprise patterns for product catalogs, cart management, and order processing.
highlights: Designed logical relational data model for e-commerce catalog and checkout workflows
Implemented Spring Data JPA repositories with MySQL integration
Configured Spring Security filter chains for secure endpoint protection
Adopted Lombok annotation processing to maintain clean, readable domain entities
challenges: Balancing relational entity integrity with performant database queries
Structuring authentication and role-based authorization for multi-endpoint protection
decisions: Selected Spring Boot 3.4.2 to leverage modern Java 17 language features
Separated domain models from persistence layer using JPA repository abstractions

title: sukuma Fleet Services
shortDescription: Dynamic transport and fleet management showcase platform built with Angular 20 standalone architecture.
longDescription: A high-performance modern web application built for Sukuma Fleet Services in Gauteng. Engineered using Angular 20 with standalone components, CSS3 keyframe animations, and modular sections for services, values, company overview, and interactive contact navigation.
highlights: Architected with Angular 20 standalone component paradigm without NgModule overhead
Built dynamic CSS scroll and keyframe animations for transport vehicle iconography
Implemented responsive modular layout covering company values, fleet services, and inquiry workflows
challenges: Delivering smooth CSS keyframe animations across diverse mobile viewports
Maintaining clean component isolation with inline styling tokens
decisions: Used Angular standalone components for streamlined bundle size and tree-shaking
Organized features into isolated domain directories (hero, services, values, contact)

title: Avatarun
shortDescription: Interactive 3D WebGL avatar lip-sync application with Three.js, React Three Fiber, and Vite.
longDescription: Avatarun is an interactive 3D WebGL experience combining React Three Fiber, Three.js, and audio-driven lip synchronization via the Rhubarb Lip Sync engine. Built with Vite for rapid development and optimized asset pipelines.
highlights: Rendered real-time 3D humanoid avatar models within the browser canvas
Integrated phoneme-to-viseme mapping via Rhubarb Lip Sync for realistic facial animation
Configured Leva dynamic debug controls for real-time 3D lighting and camera manipulation
challenges: Managing 3D asset memory consumption and smooth framerates in WebGL
Synchronizing audio timing curves with morph target animation tracks
decisions: Adopted React Three Fiber declarative scene graph over imperative Three.js loops
Used Vite as the build bundler for rapid hot module replacement of 3D shaders

title: Nedbank Mobile Clone
shortDescription: Native iOS digital banking interface clone developed in Swift with Xcode and Auto Layout.
longDescription: A native iOS application engineered in Swift and Xcode, replicating core digital banking interfaces. Emphasizes clean iOS design guidelines, native navigation controllers, secure financial presentation patterns, and pixel-accurate component rendering.
highlights: Constructed native iOS layout adhering to Apple Human Interface Guidelines (HIG)
Implemented structured banking account overview and transactional card UI
Maintained modular Xcode workspace structure for scalable view controllers
challenges: Replicating complex banking UI states across multiple iOS device form factors
Ensuring visual hierarchy while maintaining strict contrast for financial data
decisions: Built natively in Swift to maximize performance and iOS platform consistency
